semantics.intent: Display the TRAE AI coding assistant home/new-task screen, inviting the user to type a prompt, choose a model and approval mode, and start a task
semantics.scene: Dark-themed desktop application window for the TRAE AI coding agent, showing the new-task home screen with a left sidebar of navigation and projects, and a central prompt composer

result.summary: Screenshot of the TRAE AI coding assistant desktop app in dark mode. A left sidebar holds navigation (New task, Marketplace, Automation, My Artifacts), a Projects tree (Abel: Greeting, Jalankan Mode Dev Aplikasi Desktop; Default: Halo, Halo, Greeting), and an account chip (ShinRyu04, Free). The main area shows the heading "Build With TRAE" above a prompt composer with placeholder text, a Manual Approval control, model selector deepseek-v4.1-flash, mic and audio icons, a green send button, Local mode and folder picker, plus four suggestion chips: Application Development, Project Understanding, Game Creativity, Automation Tools.
uncertainty: Two identical sidebar entries 'Halo' under Default — exact distinction between them is unclear (may be separate chat/task names)
Top-left icon glyphs (panel toggle, search) are symbolic only with no text labels
Two small circular icons next to Manual Approval appear to be provider/integration avatars but their exact identity is not legible
Small filter/pin icons next to 'Projects' and 'Default' headers are too small to identify precisely
The audio-level icon next to the microphone may be a waveform/voice-input button; its exact function is unlabeled

notes: Window has standard Windows-style title bar controls (minimize, maximize, close) at top right
Prompt box has rounded corners and subtle border, occupying center of screen
Suggestion chips are pill-shaped with thin borders
Green circular send button with white up-arrow stands out as the primary action
Center layout is mostly empty dark space above and below the composer
visual.style: Dark-mode flat UI, modern IDE/chat-agent aesthetic, rounded-corner cards, muted gray palette with a single green accent, sans-serif typography
